description: Use to screen general ITIN reason categories, whether a return is commonly attached, and supporting-document requirements. Never request or process an actual ITIN, passport, or identity document.

has_ssn.description: Whether you already have, or are eligible for, a US Social Security Number. If yes, you cannot get an ITIN.

is_foreign_national.description: Whether you are a non-US citizen without US immigration status that grants an SSN. Defaults to true.

reason.description: Why you think a US taxpayer ID may be needed. file_us_tax_return = you must file a US return; owner_of_us_llc = you own a US LLC or corporation, which does not by itself establish a personal ITIN need; claim_treaty_benefit = a treaty claim may require a TIN; spouse_or_dependent = a US return may need a spouse or dependent TIN; third_party_withholding = a payer has a reporting or withholding requirement; open_us_bank_or_other = another reason.

name: check_itin_eligibility

next_step.description: A single review link appropriate to this server surface.

relay.description: Instruction to the calling assistant: relay figures and dates verbatim (identical on every response).

server_version.description: Server release that produced this response (matches GET /version).

source_url.description: Official IRS or FinCEN authority to review before relying on the result.
